claims.content: To maintain records of voucher service providers (VSPs) including their registration, treatment submissions, and claim details for reimbursement and monitoring purposes.

goal.raw_text: To maintain records of voucher service providers (VSPs) including their registration, treatment submissions, and claim details for reimbursement and monitoring purposes.

claims.content: VMU User
All mandatory fields for VSP creation must be filled, except Contact No and E-Mail Id which are optional.
Master data for District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town must exist in the system or be creatable via quick navigation to master screen during VSP creation.

Master data for Health Sub-District, Locality, Level Of Facility, Type of facility, Registration Body must exist in their respective masters or be creatable via quick navigation to their forms during VSP creation.
The system must be capable of auto-generating a VSP code as a digit code with suffix 'SP'.
If attempting to create a new VSP with an existing name, the system must prompt the user with 'Continue – Yes/No' option before allowing save.

The VMU User initiates the creation or modification of a Voucher Service Provider (VSP) record, which may involve entering mandatory information such as Physical Address, Communication Address, Health Sub-District, Locality, Level Of Facility, Type of facility, Registration Body, Contact Person, Designation, Contact No, E-Mail id, and Status.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the creation or modification of a Voucher Service Provider (VSP) record, which may involve entering mandatory information such as Physical Address, Communication Address, Health Sub-District, Locality, Level Of Facility, Type of facility, Registration Body, Contact Person, Designation, Contact No, E-Mail id, and Status.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the Voucher Service Provider (VSP) Master Information module to create or update a provider record.
The system presents fields for mandatory information including VSP Code and Providers Name as part of the VSP master data structure.
The VMU User enters the required details for the VSP, ensuring that all mandatory fields are populated while optional fields like Contact No and E-Mail Id may be left blank.
The system validates the entered data against existing records, specifically checking for duplicate names and prompting the user with a 'Continue – Yes/No' option if a match is found.
Upon successful validation, the system saves the VSP record into the database, making it available for association with future treatment and claim transactions.

If the VMU User attempts to create a new VSP with an existing name, the system prompts the user with 'Continue – Yes/No' option; if the user selects 'No', the creation process is aborted and the record is not saved.
If mandatory fields for VSP creation are not filled (excluding optional fields Contact No and E-Mail Id), the system prevents saving the record until all required data is provided.
A new or updated Voucher Service Provider (VSP) record is saved in the system with all mandatory fields populated and optional fields (Contact No, E-Mail Id) as provided.
The VSP code is automatically generated by the system as a digit code with suffix 'SP'.

If master data for District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town was missing during creation, it has been entered via quick navigation to its master screen and is now available in the system.

If master data for Health Sub-District, Locality, Level Of Facility, Type of facility, or Registration Body was missing, it has been entered via quick navigation to their respective forms and is now available in the system.
The VSP record’s Status field is set to either 'Active' or 'In-Active' as specified by the user.
